plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Cal-GETC pattern); the alternate fully-online map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 62.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. Fixed courses list only Advisories or placement-based requirements in their published descriptions (PSY 190: placement via HS GPA/other measures or a pre-statistics/intermediate algebra course; ENGL C1000/STAT C1000: placement) — not modeled as course prereqs since no plan course satisfies them. PSY 200's official prerequisite (PSYC C1000/H and PSY 190 or STAT C1000/H) and PSY 210's (PSYC C1000/H) are satisfied by plan courses and noted. Choice slots model the official 'Select One' requirements; see choice notes. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values.

courses.title: Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences or Introduction to Statistics
courses.choice_note: Select one per the official map (Cal-GETC 2; marked M). PSY 190 is recommended for all Psychology majors except those intending to transfer to Cal Poly Pomona, who should take STAT C1000/H. PSY 190 official prerequisite: enrollment requires appropriate placement (based on high school GPA and/or other measures), or completion of a pre-statistics or an intermediate algebra course (not a plan course). STAT C1000 official prerequisite: placement or completion of a course at or above elementary algebra (not a plan course).
